COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Emerging Technologies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Technologies.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emerging Technologies.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emerging Technologies.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Emerging Technologies.

   A. Input Cable Tester

7. When learning Data Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Data Structures.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Structures.

8. When learning Robotics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

9. When learning Social and Ethical Issues in Networking, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

11. When learning Data Analysis and Visualisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Analysis and Visualisation.

12. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

13. When learning Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

14. When learning Network Troubleshooting, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

15. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

16. When learning Cloud Computing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Software Project Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Emerging Technologies and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
